about.title: About
about.intro1: Associate Professor at the University of Abomey-Calavi (Benin), I dedicate my teaching and research to English as a Foreign Language (EFL) didactics, with a particular interest in pedagogical innovation and the integration of new technologies into language learning.
about.intro2: Convinced that education is the safest lever for transformation, I orient my work and teaching toward creative, embodied and contextualized pedagogy: role play, theatre-process and task-based learning as levers for transforming the learner into a competent social actor able to communicate with accuracy, elegance and efficiency in English.
about.intro3: My work is published in scientific journals such as RILALE and Ziglôbitha, and presented at international conferences, often in collaboration with colleagues from UAC and other West African universities.
about.publicationsLink: Find all my articles and scientific communications in the Publications section below.

1.description: Promotion to the CAMES grade of Professor. Teaching, research and supervision in EFL didactics, with recognized expertise in training engineering, curriculum design and consulting for educational institutions and NGOs.

2.description: Teaching in English Didactics, Research Methodology and Oral Expression Techniques, integrating role play, theatre-process and Task-Based Language Teaching to develop students' communicative competence.

3.description: Defence of a doctoral thesis devoted to Task-Based Language Teaching, role play and dramatic techniques for the development of pragmatic competence in English as a foreign language.
